metadata.description: Proof-First Development: never trust the agent's report, only an artifact observable from outside the agent.

plugins.name: proof-first
plugins.description: Blocks a turn from closing when money, auth, user data, permissions or deploys were touched without evidence a disinterested third party can confirm. Sends a clean-context subagent to go get it, and records it in a PROOF.md whose actas expire on their own when the code they cover changes.
